answer_4.quote: We carry out pairwise comparisons between our method with some baselines... Three annotators are recruited to make a preference among Win, Tie, and Lose...
answer_4.guideline: For TimeTravel, use Minimal-Edits and Coherence as metrics; for PossibleStories, use Similarity and Coherence as metrics.
